entities.summary: Aaron Samuel Altherr is a German-American professional baseball outfielder for the Chicago Dogs of the American Association of Professional Baseball. He was drafted by the Philadelphia Phillies in the ninth round of the 2009 Major League Baseball draft. Altherr has played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Phillies, San Francisco Giants, and New York Mets. He has also played in the KBO League for the NC Dinos.
